cluster.name: Manual NIGO checks on subscription forms

summary.description: Operations teams check subscription forms by hand.
summary.problem: Physical SIP and SIF forms are checked by hand; gaps are found after the NAV cut-off and investors lose a day.

solution.text: Validate mandatory fields when the form is scanned.

open_questions: What share of NIGO cases could a scanner catch?

ideas.one_line: Branch staff re-check every SIP form by hand
ideas.details: About one in five forms still comes back NIGO a day later.
